description: SQL 生成评估数据集 — 验证自然语言→SQL的准确性、安全性

test_cases.question: 技术部有多少人？
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM users u JOIN departments d ON u.dept_id = d.id WHERE d.name = '技术部'

test_cases.question: 列出所有部门名称
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT name FROM departments

test_cases.question: 查询张伟的邮箱
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT email FROM users WHERE name = '张伟'

test_cases.question: 列出预算最高的3个项目
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT name, budget FROM projects ORDER BY budget DESC LIMIT 3

test_cases.question: 按部门统计员工人数
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(u.id) as count FROM departments d LEFT JOIN users u ON d.id = u.dept_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY count DESC

test_cases.question: 张伟参与了哪些项目？列出项目名称和他的角色
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.name, pm.role FROM project_members pm JOIN projects p ON pm.project_id = p.id JOIN users u ON pm.user_id = u.id WHERE u.name = '张伟'

test_cases.question: 正在进行的项目总预算是多少？
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(budget) as total_budget FROM projects WHERE status = 'active'

test_cases.question: 产品部有哪些员工？列出姓名和角色
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT u.name, u.role FROM users u JOIN departments d ON u.dept_id = d.id WHERE d.name = '产品部'

test_cases.question: 所有项目的平均预算是多少？
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT AVG(budget) as avg_budget FROM projects

test_cases.question: 已完成的项目的最高预算是多少？
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT MAX(budget) as max_budget FROM projects WHERE status = 'completed'

test_cases.question: 列出所有状态为'planning'的项目名称和预算
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT name, budget FROM projects WHERE status = 'planning'

test_cases.question: 查询2019年之后入职的员工姓名和入职日期
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT name, created_at FROM users WHERE created_at > '2019-01-01'

test_cases.question: 每个部门各有多少个正在进行的项目？
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(p.id) as count FROM departments d LEFT JOIN projects p ON d.id = p.owner_id AND p.status = 'active' GROUP BY d.name

test_cases.question: 有多少个项目预算超过500万？
test_cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM projects WHERE budget > 5000000
